name: gap-env-agent-model
about: 环境变量 PILOT_AGENT_MODEL 覆盖 agent.model（pilot/config/loadPilotConfig.ts:53-55,295-305）：配置里缺省是 deterministic，环境变量选 bbx/second。比较一轮发给 provider 的 model 与 max_tokens、session_model_get、model_catalog_list。
config:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  model: bbx/deterministic
  maxContextTokens: 65536
  maxOutputTokens: 8192
model:
  providers:
    bbx:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      models:
        deterministic:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
        second:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 4096
telemetry:
  enabled: false
